scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy && npm run db:seed:remote
scripts.deploy:init: wrangler deploy && npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run db:seed:remote
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:seed:build && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file .generated/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: npm run db:seed:build && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file .generated/seed.sql
scripts.e2e:serve: npm run db:seed:build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e --file .generated/seed.sql && wrangler dev --port 8788 --persist-to .wrangler/e2e
